record_identity.title: Per-pane volume capacity display in file manager footer

change_definition.current_behavior: Panes show listing and cursor/sort/mark footer only; GET /api/files without displaySpecId returns bare FileStat[]; SSR bootstrap uses listDirectory only; listDirectoryViaFilesApi casts response as array.
change_definition.desired_behavior: GET always returns enriched listing with volumeStats; server provider uses statfs where available; each pane stores and displays capacity in footer; SSR bootstrap and client mount backfill hydrate stats.
success_criteria: Each pane shows total and available bytes plus free-space percentage when supported
GET response unified to enriched object; in-repo array consumers migrated
Listing succeeds when capacity collection fails
Provider, API, normalization, pane state, and presentation independently tested
change_definition.unchanged_behavior: Directory listing semantics; display filters; NSYNC volume affinity; mesh snapshot schema; bulk file operations

risks.mitigation: Non-fatal capacity failure; optional timeout in later tranche
Include capacity in footer visibility predicate

risks.description: SSR panes lack stats until client fetch
GET shape migration breaks mesh rehydrate
risks.mitigation: Migrate listDirectoryViaFilesApi in same tranche as route change
